scope_honesty: Proves offline INSTALL and offline RUNTIME for a closed contour that already has Docker: the production image is built from hash-locked wheels + digest-pinned base, saved to a tar, the local tag is REMOVED, then the image is restored purely from the tar (docker load) and served with --network none. Does NOT prove bare-metal / no-Docker install (wheelhouse) — that remains NOT VERIFIED. The 850 MB image tar is gitignored (artifacts/*), regenerated via `python -m aerobim.tools.offline_bundle build`.

checks.check: offline_bundle build (docker build + docker save tar + locks + manifest)
offline_bundle verify (sha256 of every bundle file vs manifest)
offline install: docker rmi tag then docker load -i tar
